title: South Holland roadside-grass maintenance parcel areas, reported quantities, and literature-yield comparison
publication: Verrips, K.; van Rengs, K.; Franken, N. (2021). Eindrapportage Bermmaaisel. Plennid Netherlands B.V., commissioned by Provincie Zuid-Holland; main report and Appendix 1 (LCA), March 2021.
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the accessed report. Factual values, source locations and brief contextual notes are retained for internal traceability; review reuse rights before redistribution of expressive report content.
source_locations: Main report management summary p. 5: approximately 11,000 t/year from four provincial parcels.
Main report p. 24 and Appendix 1 pp. 11–12: parcel areas and East/West quantities; South is estimated in Appendix 1 p. 20 because primary data were unavailable.
Appendix 1 p. 12: source-calculated theoretical parcel potentials using a cited 4 t DM/ha, represented as 16 t fresh/ha.

record_semantics.mowed_area: Area as reported for provincial maintenance parcels; not necessarily grass-only, eligible or accessible area.
record_semantics.reported_collected_quantity: Approximate report-level amount described as collected/removed; no underlying weigh tickets or mass basis published.
record_semantics.estimated_collected_quantity: South parcel estimate; report says primary parcel data were unavailable and uses West contractor data and scaled assumptions.
record_semantics.reported_total_collected_quantity: Approximate four-parcel provincial aggregate; not a GreenHub contract and not disaggregated to cut or parcel in the management summary.
record_semantics.source_calculated_fresh_biomass_potentia: The appendix's calculated theoretical fresh biomass yield by parcel; based on a cited literature yield factor rather than observed collection. It must not be conflated with the contractor-reported quantity.

mass_basis: The report does not state whether reported contractor tonnes are wet or dry matter. Potential-yield values are explicitly labelled fresh tonnes in the report's calculation, but the assumed conversion underpinning 4 t DM/ha to 16 t fresh/ha is not fully specified in the extracted passage.
geography: Four Zuid-Holland provincial maintenance parcels (north, east, south, west), Netherlands.
evidence_class: Published provincial project report; mix of report-level quantities, area records, one explicitly estimated parcel amount, and source-calculated literature-yield potentials.

quality_classes.B: Values explicitly reported in the provincial project report; this does not imply weighbridge verification.
quality_classes.C: Parcel potential values calculated in that report using a literature-derived per-hectare yield factor.

applicability: Phase 1 regional comparator for parcel-scale feedstock area and the gap between reported handling quantities and theoretical yield. It is not a GreenHub feedstock supply dataset or runtime input.
limitations: Underlying reference year for the annual quantities, measurement method and scale-ticket records are not given.
Wet/dry basis is not stated for reported contractor or provincial quantities; no conversion is made.

The South amount is explicitly estimated because primary data were unavailable; no North contractor amount is independently transcribed from the accessible narrative and no North value is inferred as a remainder.
The four-parcel reported total is approximate and should not be forced to equal the partial parcel quantities in this extract.

The report notes that contractor tonnages, especially South and West, may include ditch debris and can conflict with area-based expectations; it recommends centralized weighbridge receipts and machinery-hour records.
The source-calculated potential values are not observed harvests, are not access-screened, and must not be used as local GreenHub supply or as a dry-matter conversion factor.
No per-cut mass, moisture, contamination, accepted/rejected quantity, contracts, or GreenHub allocation is reported.
